# G2.1 Synthetic Discovery Maps

These fixtures are explicitly `SYNTHETIC_ONLY_NOT_EVIDENCE`. They exercise the four discovery profiles, Seed Probe boundaries, solution-neutral Opportunity Space Map, Solution Space Map breadth, initial Plan questions, immutable publication, and receipt-driven reopen/recovery.

No fixture performs research, opens a network connection, invokes an LLM or agent, claims external validation, or creates a formal Demand/Opportunity Thesis. Seeds and every map hypothesis are marked as unvalidated search inputs or questions. Evidence and audit references remain empty. Any future public identifier must use `*.synthetic.invalid`; any user-provided material must use the reserved `urn:startup-opportunity:user-provided:*` namespace.
